title: Humor as survival on the road; the East German border incident
summary: Keeping a sense of humor is vital on the road; band members reading Nazi books were held up for hours at the East German border.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: -- also part of a way to survive in a band that was on the road, they needed to have a balance of many --

Well, I think it helps a great deal because of the kind of environment and the hardship of the road, which is -- can be a hardship. The fact that you keep your sense of humor is very important. And one way to do it is -- and every band I've ever had has been pretty much in the same fashion. The current group is one of the maddest groups of young players I've ever been around, as far as their humor is concerned.
Absolutely, yeah. But they aren't the kinds of things you can express and tell about. You had to be there.

Like, when we were crossing the border not too long ago into East Germany, and two or three of these guys with this really sick sense of humor, had -- were reading books on Nazis and had all this material out as the inspectors were going through. And, of course, they got held at the border about two and a half hours longer than they should have

been.

But they thought it was marvelous, and then of course the inspectors were picking up their copies of Playboy and the other porno magazines, and inspecting them, you know. And really inspecting them very well.
So our guys are pretty nutty.
